target: P(>= 1 S-NPP VIIRS 375 m presumed-vegetation detection in the 0.25 deg cell within 7 days)
equal_footing: Same 600,000 training rows (seeded subsample), same calibration and test rows for every model
selection_rule: A candidate replaces XGBoost only if it improves test Brier by >= 2 % relative AND ROC-AUC by >= 0.005 on the main split AND is not worse in Brier on any rolling origin.
decision: XGBoost retained: hist_gradient_boosting (best alternative) does not meet the rule
day_night: Not applicable: the target counts day and night detections together within a 7-day window.

climatology.algorithm: Seasonal recurrence (same weeks in earlier years) mapped to probability by isotonic regression
climatology.calibration: isotonic regression on label windows ending 2021-12-31 < end <= 2023-12-31
climatology.feature_provenance: FIRMS S-NPP VIIRS + MODIS detections (repository archives), NASA POWER daily weather, MCD12Q1 land cover; all windows end at the issue date
limitations: Target is a detectable S-NPP hotspot within 7 days, not a verified ignition
Cloud cover and data gaps hide fires; labels in gap weeks are dropped, not set to zero

logistic.algorithm: L2 logistic regression (lbfgs, C=1) on standardised features + missing-value indicators
